comparison.objective: Replace a robot-arm timing pulley and reinstall long and short screws in remembered locations; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve robot-maintenance tool work and screws. Pulley replacement tests disassembly, part exchange, screw handling, and memory; candidate tests a retained fine adjustment, counterholding, bounded locking torque, and response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Pulley and four screws must be correctly reinstalled according to hidden length/depth mapping; candidate must pass two quantified impacts and retain collar position.
comparison.reason: The common maintenance context and screw operation are generic; component replacement with memory does not test damper commissioning.
